## ⚡ Minimum Essential Watchlist (If Short on Time)

Just want to understand Doomsday without watching everything? Focus on these **15 must-watches**:

1. 🔑 Iron Man (2008)
2. 🔑 Captain America: The First Avenger (2011)
3. 🔑 The Avengers (2012)
4. 🔑 Captain America: The Winter Soldier (2014)
5. 🔑 Avengers: Age of Ultron (2015)
6. 🔑 Captain America: Civil War (2016)
7. 🔑 Avengers: Infinity War (2018)
8. 🔑 Avengers: Endgame (2019)
9. 🔑 Loki (Season 1 + Season 2) — *Multiverse & Kang setup*
10. 🔑 WandaVision — *Scarlet Witch arc*
11. 🔑 Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
12. 🔑 Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania — *Kang/Doom setup*
13. 🔑 Deadpool & Wolverine — *Multiverse stakes*
14. 🔑 Captain America: Brave New World
15. 🔑 Thunderbolts*

---

> [!TIP]
> **Who is Doom?** Doctor Doom (Victor Von Doom) is set to be the main villain in Doomsday, replacing Kang. He is played by **Robert Downey Jr.** The Doom storyline connects through the multiverse and Latverian monarchy arcs introduced in Phase 5.
